figurative_meaning_en: A person with a crooked or deceitful nature
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খুব আড়া মানুষ, কখনো বিশ্বাস করা যায় না।
এই লোকটার আড়া স্বভাব সবাই জানে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a very crooked person; you can never trust him.
Everyone knows about this man's crooked nature.
note: Refers to indirect or sly behavior in social interactions
